`. Build: - a section with `id="about"`: an `

`, a paragraph, a list of three things to bring, and a picture with alt text; - a section with `id="results"`: an `

` and a table with a heading row and three players; - the two winners marked with `class="winner"` and coloured by one `.winner` rule. Menu links jump to a section when their `href` matches its `id`: click About and Results to check. ### Milestone 3: sign-up and footer Goals only this time: - a section with `id="join"`: an `

` and a form with at least two labelled fields (one a drop-down) and a button, every label linked to its box; - a footer after `

` with contact details; - a `footer { }` rule to colour it. ### Test the page Click every menu link and every label. A link that does not jump has an `href` that does not match an `id`. A label that does not find its box has a `for` that does not match its `id`. ## Make it yours ```step stage: make try: { playground: html, starter: "page.html#sol-m3", height: 560 } hint: - "Change one thing at a time: the club name, then the words, then the colours." - "Pictures you can use: `trophy.svg`, `medal.svg`, `book.svg`, `ball.svg`, `star.svg`, `music.svg`." check: { type: reflect, text: "I changed the club, its words and its colours, and every link and label still works." } expected: page.html#sol-yours ``` Turn the page into one for a club or event you care about: a new name, your own words, your own colours, and a picture with alt text that fits. Add a rule or two of your own, such as a `font-family` for the headings. Then click every link and every label again. ```teacher summary: Students build a coloured club page in three milestones with fading support (header and menu, sections with a list, picture and results table, then a sign-up form and footer), then make it their own. time: 90 timing: "Plan 10 min · Milestone 1 15 min · Milestone 2 25 min · Milestone 3 25 min · Make it yours 15 min" goals: - I can plan a page as a list of parts. - I can build a header with a jump-link menu, sections, a results table and a sign-up form. - I can colour the page with tag rules and pick the winners with a class. - I can test that every link and label works. before: | Read the challenge primer "Running the final challenge", then build milestone 1 yourself and plan milestones 2 and 3 on paper. There is **nothing new** in this lesson, and no layout: Layout and components lays this same page out. Every milestone recalls earlier lessons: tags and nesting, tag rules and colours, lists, links, pictures and alt text, classes, tables, page sections, jump links, and forms. Support fades on purpose: milestone 1 gives the exact rules, milestone 2 an outline in comments, milestone 3 only the goals. Finishing this lesson marks **Challenge complete** on the course page. running: - "Plan the page: match each part to how it is built. Students who are stuck can use **Reset to this task's start** to load a working milestone 1. Now the menu links jump." - "Milestone 3: goals only. Ask students to plan the form's fields before typing. Click every label and every menu link." - "Make it yours: any club or event. Encourage pictures with good alt text and readable colours." stuck: - see: A menu link does not jump. ask: Does the href, after the #, match the section's id exactly? fix: Make each pair match exactly, capitals included, and keep the # in the href only. - see: Clicking a label does nothing. ask: Does the label's for match the box's id? fix: Make them identical, for example for="name" and id="name". - see: Every table row is gold, or no row is. ask: Does the class go on the row's opening tag, and does the rule start with a dot? fix: Write for the winners and .winner { } in the style block. - see: Part of the page suddenly looks wrong after an edit. ask: Which closing tag did you add or move last? fix: Check that every tag closes, in the right order, and that every property ends with a semicolon. stretch: "Add a second table, a second list, or a rule that changes the font of the headings with font-family. Then look at the Layout and components challenge, which lays this page out." support: "Let students use Reset to this task's start at each milestone, so everyone reaches milestone 3. Pair students for milestone 3: one plans the form, one the footer." leads: "Layout and components takes this same page and lays it out: menu in a row, cards, a hero, and a form styled as a card.
